verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Privacy Portal can detect and classify customer data, and that consent management enforces end-user preferences. Neither documents per-destination hashing, masking, or field-level filtering of sensitive attributes. Functions are a developer building block for writing custom JavaScript destinations, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes
